parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO public.bridge_event_log (event_id, payload, processed)
  VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb, false)
  ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins) AS is_new;
UPDATE public.bridge_event_log SET processed = true WHERE event_id = $1;
